# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 63 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 47 | Coptic

---

## Saying 63

**1** Jesus said: "There was a rich man who had a great deal of money. He said: 'I shall invest my money so that I may sow, reap, plant, and fill my barns with produce, that I might lack nothing.' Such were his thoughts. But that very night he died. Let him who has ears hear."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Barns" preferred over "storehouses" — more familiar in English parable tradition (cf. Luke 12)
- "Invest" for putting money to use — economically precise
- "Such were his thoughts" — compression of "these were the things he was thinking in his heart"
